# Camella Projects — Sta. Maria, Bulakan, Provence, Baliwag & San Ildefonso

> Five Camella communities in Bulacan, Philippines. Verified house models and sample computations from the official project files, and a consultant who answers only from those files.

## Projects

- Camella Sta. Maria — Km 37, Brgy. Pulong Buhangin, Sta. Maria, Bulacan. Bundle Lots Promo: get up to 40% / 50% / 60% outright discount.
- Camella Bulakan — Brgy. Matungao, Bulakan, Bulacan.
- Camella Provence — McArthur Highway, Brgy. Longos, Malolos, Bulacan.
- Camella Baliwag — Brgy. Tangos, Baliwag, Bulacan.
- Camella San Ildefonso — Brgy. Garlang, San Ildefonso, Bulacan. 7.8 hectares, 403 units.

## House models

Models vary by project and include Bella, Cara, Dana, Dani, Ella, Freya, Greta, Arielle, Brielle, Criselle and Ezabelle. Floor areas and minimum lot sizes are listed per model on the page, taken from the official project files.

## Sample computations

Sample computations on the page are quoted from the official project files, including total contract price, reservation fee, downpayment terms, and bank financing. Prices are snapshots from those files and are subject to change; confirm current figures with the consultant.
